verdict.rationale: Bevy documents asset hot-reloading (scenes, textures, meshes) and touts 'instant feedback...without app restarts or recompiles,' plus a 'fast compiles' config targeting 0.8-3.0s builds, which shortens the edit-run loop. However, Bevy game logic is compiled Rust, not a scripting language, so actual code/script changes still require a recompile (mitigated only by fast-compile tooling), and no evidence shows true hot-reload of gameplay logic itself. Missing for 10: evidence of hot-reloading actual game logic/script code (not just assets), and any hands-on developer confirmation of near-instant iteration on logic changes.
